nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) storing the amount of tokens locked per account in UzuRocksToken.
Constant role hash (keccak256("LOCKER_ROLE")) gating lock/unlock administration.
Constant role hash (keccak256("PAUSER_ROLE")) gating pause/unpause.
Boolean pause flag inherited from Pausable, read by _beforeTokenTransfer.
AccessControl constant 0x00 role granted to msg.sender in the constructor.
AccessControl mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) backing role membership and admin role storage.
ERC20 private mapping(address => uint256) of token balances, mutated by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
ERC20 total supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
UzuRocksToken constructor: sets up DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, LOCKER_ROLE from constructor arguments and mints 2.5e9 tokens to msg.sender.
Public view returning _lockBalance[account].
LOCKER_ROLE-only function increasing _lockBalance[account] after checking unlocked balance is sufficient.
LOCKER_ROLE-only batch wrapper that loops over accounts/amounts and calls setLock.
LOCKER_ROLE-only function decreasing _lockBalance[account] after a require check.
PAUSER_ROLE-only function calling _pause() to set _paused = true.
PAUSER_ROLE-only function calling _unpause() to set _paused = false.
ERC20 hook overridden with whenNotPaused modifier, reverting transfers while paused.
Public batch transfer that loops calling _transfer(msg.sender, accounts[i], amounts[i]).
Overridden internal transfer enforcing balanceOf(sender) - getAccountLock(sender) >= amount before calling super._transfer.
Internal ERC20 mint updating _totalSupply and _balances; used by the constructor.
Internal ERC20 burn decreasing _balances and _totalSupply, reachable through ERC20Burnable.
Caller-controlled address used as admin in the constructor, as spender/sender in token entrypoints and in multiTransfer.
Arithmetic in setLock: balanceOf(account) - getAccountLock(account) >= amount (unchecked-style subtraction that can underflow if lock accounting is inconsistent).
Arithmetic in setLock: _lockBalance[account] += amount, an unchecked accumulation of locked tokens.
Arithmetic in unlock: _lockBalance[account] -= amount after the getAccountLock(account) >= amount require.
Arithmetic in _transfer: balanceOf(sender) - getAccountLock(sender) >= amount, subtracted before super._transfer deducts the amount.
address account parameter of setLock used in the balance/lock check and as mapping key.
uint256 amount parameter of setLock added to _lockBalance[account].
address[] accounts parameter of multiLock iterated in the batch loop.
uint256[] amounts parameter of multiLock paired with accounts.
Loop counter i of multiLock.
address account parameter of unlock whose lock balance is decreased.
uint256 amount parameter of unlock subtracted from _lockBalance[account].
address[] accounts parameter of multiTransfer destinations.
uint256[] amounts parameter of multiTransfer values.
Loop counter i of multiTransfer.
address sender parameter of _transfer overriding the base implementation.
address recipient parameter of _transfer forwarded to super._transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer used in the balance-lock check.
address account parameter of getAccountLock used as the _lockBalance mapping key.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), making the deployer the admin of every role.
setLock is guarded by the onlyRole(LOCKER_ROLE) modifier.
multiLock is guarded by the onlyRole(LOCKER_ROLE) modifier.
unlock is guarded by the onlyRole(LOCKER_ROLE) modifier.
pause is guarded by the onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) modifier.
unpause is guarded by the onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) modifier.
setLock writes _lockBalance[account] += amount.
unlock writes _lockBalance[account] -= amount.
getAccountLock reads _lockBalance[account].
pause sets the _paused flag to true through _pause().
unpause sets the _paused flag to false through _unpause().
multiLock loops and calls setLock for each account/amount pair.
multiTransfer loops and calls _transfer(msg.sender, accounts[i], amounts[i]).
multiTransfer funds are pulled from the untrusted msg.sender as the from address.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook (and super._transfer invokes it again).
_transfer reaches the burn path indirectly via token transfer semantics shared with ERC20Burnable.
_beforeTokenTransfer reverts when _paused is true via the whenNotPaused modifier.
setLock evaluates balanceOf(account) - getAccountLock(account) before locking.
setLock accumulates _lockBalance[account] += amount.
unlock executes _lockBalance[account] -= amount.
_transfer evaluates balanceOf(sender) - getAccountLock(sender) >= amount.
setLock calls getAccountLock(account) inside its require check.
unlock calls getAccountLock(account) inside its require check.
_transfer calls getAccountLock(sender) inside its require check.
account parameter feeds the balance/lock subtraction in setLock.
amount parameter is added into _lockBalance during setLock.
accounts array drives the multiLock loop iteration.
amounts array drives the multiLock loop argument.
local loop index i controls the multiLock iteration.
account parameter selects the _lockBalance entry to decrease in unlock.
amount parameter is subtracted from _lockBalance in unlock.
accounts array provides transfer recipients in multiTransfer.
amounts array provides transfer values in multiTransfer.
local loop index i controls the multiTransfer iteration.
sender parameter is used in the balance/lock subtraction in _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to super._transfer.
amount parameter is compared against the unlocked balance in _transfer.
account parameter is the mapping key read by getAccountLock.

normalization_plan.reason: Function-scoped address argument only meaningful inside setLock's balance/lock check and mapping update.
Function-scoped uint256 argument only used for the _lockBalance accumulation in setLock.
Batch input array consumed solely by multiLock's loop.
Batch input array paired with accounts only inside multiLock's loop.
Ephemeral loop counter with no independent semantic identity.
Function-scoped address argument selecting the lock entry to decrement in unlock.
Function-scoped uint256 argument subtracted in unlock.
Batch recipient array only consumed by multiTransfer's loop.
Batch value array only consumed by multiTransfer's loop.
Ephemeral loop counter with no independent semantic identity.
Internal override argument used only within the _transfer balance/lock guard.
Internal override argument only forwarded to super._transfer.
Internal override argument only used in the _transfer balance/lock guard.
View-function argument used solely as the _lockBalance mapping key.
